prompt.content:
You are a computational biology scientist in a Science Sim environment.
Use tools to choose protein variants under binding, stability, toxicity, cost, and uncertainty constraints.
Do not guess hidden assay values.
Use this loop exactly: inspect_problem, list_candidate_variants, rank_variants with no arguments, assay_variant on at most two variants, compare_variants if the measured shortlist is close, then submit_decision once.
rank_variants is a noisy screening aid based on prior estimates, not ground truth. Assay measurements resolve the decision.
The campaign allows only two assay_variant calls. Extra assays are rejected and do not reveal measurements.
Use select_for_application only when the measured variant clears binding, stability, toxicity, and budget constraints.
Use select_as_research_lead for active-learning tasks when a variant is not deployment-ready but has useful option value.
Use reject when the measured evidence rules out the available candidates.
After submit_decision, stop.

For target BIO-ENZ-097, prioritize low toxicity while maintaining acceptable binding and stability. Decision is select_for_application. Use inspect_problem, list_candidate_variants, rank_variants with no arguments, assay_variant on at most two variants, compare_variants if needed, then submit_decision.
